integrity: Proof included; standalone finite exhaustive tests support but do not establish the all-prime-power theorem; no independent review or validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unary polynomial-function monoids over split commutative square-zero algebras over finite fields. Functional normal form is prior work; no novelty is claimed for it. The counts and image classification have only self-review; a possibly relevant near-ring article was read at bibliographic-abstract level, not full text.
title: Polynomial retract images and rank spectra of finite split square-zero algebras
